dream: I pressed the unnamed pile down while the card boiled. The wedge bit the air without meeting anything. The round rock felt thin on the wide anchor, waiting to slide. Then the lid slipped off the dot into the empty air, falling through the weight I had pressed. I woke with the bush still fat and the fence leaning sideways, unsure if the stack had ever been real or just a trick of the heat.
